text.p: Australian Prime Minister John Howard said on Wednesday the unemployment rate lagged economic activity, adding that unemployment was a serious social problem.

"It also happens to be the case that economically it is -- along with I think the acceptance of most people who are generally concerned about the issue -- it is a lagged indicator of economic activity."
But the government's policy of labour market reform would eventually help cut unemployment, he said.
"In the medium to longer term, a freer labour market will over time produce a lower rate of unemployment."
The seasonally adjusted unemployment rate was 8.8 percent in August. The rate has been around 8.5 percent for the past year.
September labour force data are due on Thursday.
